Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1628478. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter to exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
